title: The French brothers and the French and White band
summary: Morris, Bob and Johnny French had their own band called French and White.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Oh, back to those French brothers. You said there were about four of them, Morris.
Bob and Johnny. And all of them, three of them.
Yeah. They had a band too. They had a band the same. Well, they left to Edward. They had a band too. They called it the French and White.
French and White. The boy played the violin. He used to play with us too. But Bullwide, he played the violin. And Morris played trombone. So they went by that two names, French and White.
